text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated January 23, 2019, regarding the property located at 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11, for Items 1, 3, 5 and 6 only. 2. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated January 23, 2019, regarding the property located at 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11, and in doing so granted and extension of time to May 31, 2019, for Items 2, 4 and 7 only.
